summary: EFCAR, LLC, depositor for Exeter Automobile Receivables Trust 2022-4, filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Capital Contribution Agreement dated September 15, 2026, with Exeter Finance LLC and the 2022-2 through 2022-5 trusts, acknowledged by Citibank, N.A. as indenture trustee. The pact lets EFCAR, as equity holder, make limited capital contributions to the trusts. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated. This is a routine ABS structural/credit-support agreement, not a special situation; watch trust performance and any draw triggers.
